findings.title: Bodily demand opens retracing
findings.claim: The spoken request for food can become the first audible form of bodily recognition: after the travelers have crossed, their fatigue gives the missed passage a voice and opens the path back to what was overlooked.
findings.mechanism: The focus speech carrier at 18:62:3:1 contacts the distinct fatigue trigger at 18:62:12:1, the supplied 18:63 and 18:64 recollection-and-return sequence, and the same-surah 18:19 scene where spoken direction sends a companion toward provisions. The contact changes speech from a mere report into the hinge that exposes overshoot.
findings.reader_payoff: The meal request becomes part of the journey's orientation: bodily limitation does not only interrupt progress but can make a missed point sayable and retraceable.
findings.containment: The ordinary meaning of direct speech, fatigue, and a request for food remains intact. The packet does not establish a mechanical causal law from fatigue to memory, nor does it identify the requested meal beyond the supplied qualified sequence.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus anchor and citable cross-run record are trusted; the duplicate reader-walk support is legacy_unbound, so the wider causal relation remains qualified rather than lexical fact.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus fatigue word, the supplied recollection and return references 18:63 and 18:64, and the registered 18:19 food-direction scene independently place spoken demand at a point where a missed passage can be exposed.
branch_activations.activation: The speech event contacts bodily depletion and the later remembrance-and-return sequence, so the utterance becomes the audible hinge between passing beyond a point and recognizing the error.

branch_activations.boundary: This retains ordinary speech and does not claim that fatigue always causes recollection or that the 18:19 provision scene is identical to the focus event.

findings.title: Fatigue becomes a waymark
findings.claim: The fatigue named after the crossing can be felt as more than travel cost: it can mark the point where attention failed, making the wrong continuation perceptible and allowing return.
findings.mechanism: The focus fatigue carrier at 18:62:12:1 contacts the focus crossing at 18:62:2:1, the supplied 18:24 pattern of forgetting followed by remembering and nearer guidance, and the exact 9:120 travel field that places thirst, fatigue, and hunger together. These distinct triggers let the fatigue branch and the raised-marker branch explain one another.
findings.reader_payoff: The complaint acquires directional force. Weariness can disclose where the travelers have gone past the point that mattered, so retracing is an intelligible response rather than an arbitrary reversal.
findings.containment: The primary reading that the travelers are tired and ask for food remains recoverable. The packet does not claim that every hardship is a sign, that 18:24 or 9:120 narrates these travelers, or that a wrong direction is the only reading.

epistemic.reason: The focus-anchored candidate is trusted, while the represented retrospective is legacy_unbound; exact contextual connections bound the interpretation without turning it into a lexical gloss.

findings.title: Weariness as a boundary marker
findings.claim: The fatigue can carry a more specific boundary-marker resonance: where attention missed the junction, the body installs a sign that enters speech through the request for food and sends the travelers back.
findings.mechanism: The focus occurrence 18:62:12:1 carries the registered fatigue and boundary-marker branches. The focus crossing at 18:62:2:1, the 18:24 forgetting-and-guidance connection, the 9:120 travel-fatigue field, and the supplied 18:63/18:64 sequence independently activate the contact; the fatigue is thereby read as a sign located at a missed boundary.
findings.reader_payoff: A bodily limit becomes legible as corrective orientation. The return is not detached from the complaint; it is disclosed through the complaint's timing and felt pressure.
findings.containment: The ordinary fatigue reading remains primary and intact. This legacy-unbound marker image is exploratory, does not assert a literal stone or physical sign, and does not make every bodily limit a guidance signal.

epistemic.reason: The registered branch references and exact contextual connections bound the reading, but its marker synthesis comes from legacy_unbound reader-walk material rather than a trusted cross-run finding.

findings.title: Provision brought into shared reach
findings.claim: The focus imperative can also carry the contour of bringing provision to a shared recipient: the meal request is an action that moves needed food toward the travelers.
findings.mechanism: The focus occurrence 18:62:5:1 carries root_000009/B002's bring-and-present facet. The supplied wider scenes at 18:19, 20:10, 27:7, and 28:29 independently return the same root field through companions or travelers seeking and bringing food, news, fire, or useful aid; the 18:19 connection gives the closest same-surah food trigger.
findings.reader_payoff: The imperative becomes practical coordination within travel: provision is not only an object named by the request but something brought into the group's reach.
findings.containment: The ordinary request for the morning meal remains intact. The packet does not identify the focus meal with any wider provision, nor does it infer target-side morphology beyond the supplied Arabic and connection notes.

epistemic.reason: Exact wider Arabic and registered connection notes supply the triggers; the contextual return is interpretive and does not rely on an invented target morphology.
